title: Buy Crypto With Binance P2P - Now Available Directly Within Binance Wallet!
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, We are pleased to announce that users in  selected regions  can now buy crypto directly within their Binance Wallet using Binance P2P. This offers the best value onramp with support for local currencies and multiple payment methods. The new “Buy with P2P” service, available on Binance Wallet, is powered by  Binance Pay Onchain . This feature offers a variety of payment options such as bank transfer via Binance P2P, while the system automatically matches users with the best available offers for a fast and seamless trading experience. Fund with P2P via Binance Wallet How to Buy Crypto with P2P on Binance Wallet: Open your Binance Wallet, tap  [Receive] , then select  [Buy with P2P] . Enter the amount of fiat you want to spend, select the token you wish to buy, and choose your preferred payment method by tapping the  [Pay with {Payment methods}]  drop-down menu. Tap  [Continue]  to proceed with the order. Review the order details, including any fees that may be charged depending on the payment method. Tap [Confirm] to continue the order. Follow the instructions to complete your order.
